description: Header file defining logging macros, classes, and functions for the Starboard logging API, including LogMessage classes, log level controls, and macros for logging and assertions.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Class for constructing and managing log messages, including stream access and message formatting.

classes.name: LogMessageVoidify
classes.description: Helper class to facilitate conditional logging without evaluating stream content when condition is false.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Struct representing a stack dump object with a specified number of frames to skip.

methods.name: SetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level for logging output.

methods.name: GetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current minimum log level for logging.

methods.name: StringToLogLevel
methods.description: Converts a string representation of log level to its enum value.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Triggers a breakpoint or debugger break.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructor for creating a log message with file, line, and priority; destructor handles message finalization.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the output stream for appending log message content.

methods.name: LogMessageVoidify
methods.description: Class to suppress stream evaluation when condition is false.
